# Overview

Researchers and stakeholders interested in understanding how the project was developed may refer to the following PDF reports for further details. These reports document the characteristics of the raw data, troubleshooting strategies for algorithmic development, and interpret benchmarks and outcomes assessing algorithm performance and estimating the degree of accuracy achieved.

Note that in May 2026, an updated version of the raw data was provided in a format different from that of the version saved in July 2023 and provided in Summer 2025. As a result, data processing was divided into two paths: one for the **2023 Format** and one for the **2026 Format**.

2026 versions of comparable sections should be treated as the most current methodology applicable to ongoing research. Insights derived from the 2023 Format are assumed to apply to the 2026 Format as well. Unexpected outcomes or shortcomings in algorithm performance identified in the 2023 drafts were used to inform improvements applied in the 2026 version.

# Project Objectives

1. **REVIEW:** Evaluate the raw data and previously outlined cleaning, validation, and harmonization methods employed by [Dr. Insang Song](https://sigmafelix.wixsite.com/mysite) for accuracy and identify opportunities for improvement.

2. **PREPARATION:** Implement identified improvements to prepare the dataset for analysis and distribution to qualifying collaborators.

3. **METRICS:** Calculate the metrics necessary for dynamic visualization.

Additionally, the project pipeline should be reasonably reproducible for future collaborators and readily adaptable to potential changes in project scope.
